footer.description: Open-source ecommerce powered by Spree REST API, TypeScript SDK, and Next.js. Self-host it. Own your data. Zero platform fees.

home.heroDescription: A production-ready, open-source storefront built with Next.js, React, and the Spree TypeScript SDK. Self-host it. Own your stack. No vendor lock-in. Zero platform fees.
home.qualityDescription: Carefully curated selection of the best products.
home.shippingDescription: Quick and reliable delivery to your doorstep.
home.supportDescription: Our team is here to help you anytime.
